connector.name: Advanced GitLab MCP server
connector.registryDescription: 58 CQRS tools exposing 230 GitLab operations across 26 entity types
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package gitlab-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the structured-world account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: GITLAB_TOKEN

env.name: GITLAB_API_URL
env.description: GitLab instance API URL for self-hosted instances (defaults to https://gitlab.com)

env.name: GITLAB_READ_ONLY_MODE
env.description: Enable read-only mode (disable all manage_* write operations)
